import re
import string

packets = rdpcap('/work/workstation.pcap')

def extract_domain_info(pkt_bytes):
    """Extract ASCII text from packet bytes, focusing on DNS-like content"""
    # Decode with latin-1 (preserves all bytes as-is but interprets as text)
    try:
        ascii_text = pkt_bytes.decode('latin-1', errors='ignore')
